column1: Whisk the melted butter, honey, garlic, chipotle, salt and pepper together.
Pour half the glaze over the salmon and marinate at least 15 minutes, or up to 8 hours in the fridge. Save the other half.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C), or heat a grill to medium-high.
Oven: bake on a lined baking sheet 15–20 minutes (about 10 minutes per inch of thickness) until it reaches 145°F (63°C). Grill: cook skin-side down about 15 minutes until cooked through.
Brush with the reserved glaze just before serving.
